lines: 死人不能赞美耶和华；
下到寂静中的也都不能。
The dead don’t praise Yah
neither any who go down into silence;
死人不能赞美耶和华；
下到寂静中的也都不能。
死人不能讚美耶和華；
下到寂靜中的也都不能。
The dead don’t praise Yah
neither any who go down into silence;
The dead do not give praise to the Lord; or those who go down to the underworld.
我将你的话藏在心里，
免得我得罪你。
I have hidden your word in my heart
that I might not sin against you.
我将你的话藏在心里，
免得我得罪你。
我將你的話藏在心裏，
免得我得罪你。
I have hidden your word in my heart
that I might not sin against you.
I have kept your sayings secretly in my heart
so that I might do no sin against you.
我又要遵行你的命令，
这命令素来是我所爱的；
我也要思想你的律例。
I reach out my hands for your commandments
which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
我又要遵行你的命令，
这命令素来是我所爱的；
我也要思想你的律例。
我又要遵行你的命令，
這命令素來是我所愛的；
我也要思想你的律例。
I reach out my hands for your commandments
which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
And so that my hands may be stretched out to you; and I will give thought to your rules.
儿女是耶和华所赐的产业；
所怀的胎是他所给的赏赐。
Behold
children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
儿女是耶和华所赐的产业；
所怀的胎是他所给的赏赐。
兒女是耶和華所賜的產業；
所懷的胎是他所給的賞賜。
Behold
children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
See
sons are a heritage from the Lord; the fruit of the body is his reward.
看哪，弟兄和睦同居，
是何等的善，何等的美！
这好比那贵重的油浇在亚伦的头上，
流到胡须，又流到他的衣襟；
See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
It is like the precious oil on the head
that ran down on the beard
even Aaron’s beard; that came down on the edge of his robes;
看哪，弟兄和睦同居，
是何等的善，何等的美！
这好比那贵重的油浇在亚伦的头上，
流到胡须，又流到他的衣襟；
看哪，弟兄和睦同居，
是何等的善，何等的美！
這好比那貴重的油澆在亞倫的頭上，
流到鬍鬚，又流到他的衣襟；
See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
It is like the precious oil on the head
that ran down on the beard
even Aaron’s beard; that came down on the edge of his robes;
<A Song of the going up. Of David.> See how good and how pleasing it is for brothers to be living together in harmony!
It is like oil of great price on the head
flowing down over the face
even Aaron's face: coming down to the edge of his robe;
他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。
He heals the broken in heart
and binds up their wounds.
他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。
他醫好傷心的人，裹好他們的傷處。
He heals the broken in heart
and binds up their wounds.
He makes the broken-hearted well
and puts oil on their wounds.
凡有气息的都要赞美耶和华！你们要赞美耶和华！
Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
凡有气息的都要赞美耶和华！你们要赞美耶和华！
凡有氣息的都要讚美耶和華！你們要讚美耶和華！
Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
Let everything which has breath give praise to the Lord. Let the Lord be praised.
耶和华，我的力量啊，
我爱你！
I love you
Yahweh
my strength.
耶和华，我的力量啊，
我爱你！
耶和華，我的力量啊，
我愛你！
I love you
Yahweh
my strength.
他使我的灵魂苏醒，
为自己的名引导我走义路。
He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
他使我的灵魂苏醒，
为自己的名引导我走义路。
他使我的靈魂甦醒，
為自己的名引導我走義路。
He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
He gives new life to my soul: he is my guide in the ways of righteousness because of his name.
要等候耶和华！当壮胆，
坚固你的心！我再说，
要等候耶和华！
Wait for Yahweh. Be strong
and let your heart take courage. Yes
wait for Yahweh.
要等候耶和华！当壮胆，
坚固你的心！我再说，
要等候耶和华！
要等候耶和華！當壯膽，
堅固你的心！我再說，
要等候耶和華！
Wait for Yahweh. Be strong
and let your heart take courage. Yes
wait for Yahweh.
Let your hope be in the Lord: take heart and be strong; yes
let your hope be in the Lord.
义人呼求，耶和华听见了，
便救他们脱离一切患难。
耶和华靠近伤心的人，
拯救灵性痛悔的人。
The righteous cry
and Yahweh hears
and delivers them out of all their troubles.
Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart
and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
义人呼求，耶和华听见了，
便救他们脱离一切患难。
耶和华靠近伤心的人，
拯救灵性痛悔的人。
義人呼求，耶和華聽見了，
便救他們脫離一切患難。
耶和華靠近傷心的人，
拯救靈性痛悔的人。
The righteous cry
and Yahweh hears
and delivers them out of all their troubles.
Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart
and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
The cry of the upright comes before the Lord
and he takes them out of all their troubles.
The Lord is near the broken-hearted; he is the saviour of those whose spirits are crushed down.
耶和华靠近伤心的人，
拯救灵性痛悔的人。
Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart
and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
耶和华靠近伤心的人，
拯救灵性痛悔的人。
耶和華靠近傷心的人，
拯救靈性痛悔的人。
Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart
and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
The Lord is near the broken-hearted; he is the saviour of those whose spirits are crushed down.
你们和我当称耶和华为大，
一同高举他的名。
Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let us exalt his name together.
你们和我当称耶和华为大，
一同高举他的名。
你們和我當稱耶和華為大，
一同高舉他的名。
Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let us exalt his name together.
O give praise to the Lord with me; let us be witnesses together of his great name.
又要以耶和华为乐，
他就将你心里所求的赐给你。
Also delight yourself in Yahweh
and he will give you the desires of your heart.
又要以耶和华为乐，
他就将你心里所求的赐给你。
又要以耶和華為樂，
他就將你心裏所求的賜給你。
Also delight yourself in Yahweh
and he will give you the desires of your heart.
So will your delight be in the Lord
and he will give you your heart's desires.
当将你的事交托耶和华，
并倚靠他，他就必成全。
Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him
and he will do this:
当将你的事交托耶和华，
并倚靠他，他就必成全。
當將你的事交託耶和華，
並倚靠他，他就必成全。
Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him
and he will do this:
Put your life in the hands of the Lord; have faith in him and he will do it.
耶和华啊，求你因我的仇敌，
凭你的公义引领我，
使你的道路在我面前正直。
Lead me
Yahweh
in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
耶和华啊，求你因我的仇敌，
凭你的公义引领我，
使你的道路在我面前正直。
耶和華啊，求你因我的仇敵，
憑你的公義引領我，
使你的道路在我面前正直。
Lead me
Yahweh
in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
Be my guide
O Lord
in the ways of your righteousness
because of those who are against me; make your way straight before my face.
求你使我仍得救恩之乐，
赐我乐意的灵扶持我，
Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
求你使我仍得救恩之乐，
赐我乐意的灵扶持我，
求你使我仍得救恩之樂，
賜我樂意的靈扶持我，
Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
Give me back the joy of your salvation; let a free spirit be my support.
神所要的祭就是忧伤的灵；
神阿，忧伤痛悔的心，
你必不轻看。
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. A broken and contrite heart
O God
you will not despise.
神所要的祭就是忧伤的灵；
神阿，忧伤痛悔的心，
你必不轻看。
神所要的祭就是憂傷的靈；
神阿，憂傷痛悔的心，
你必不輕看。
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. A broken and contrite heart
O God
you will not despise.
The offerings of God are a broken spirit; a broken and sorrowing heart
O God
you will not put from you.
他们说：来吧，我们将他们剪灭，
使他们不再成国！使以色列的名不再被人记念！
“Come,” they say
“let’s destroy them as a nation
that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
他们说：来吧，我们将他们剪灭，
使他们不再成国！使以色列的名不再被人记念！
他們說：來吧，我們將他們剪滅，
使他們不再成國！使以色列的名不再被人記念！
“Come,” they say
“let’s destroy them as a nation
that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
They have said
Come
let us put an end to them as a nation; so that the name of Israel may go out of man's memory.
我必不背弃我的约，
也不改变我口中所出的。
I will not break my covenant
nor alter what my lips have uttered.
我必不背弃我的约，
也不改变我口中所出的。
我必不背棄我的約，
也不改變我口中所出的。
I will not break my covenant
nor alter what my lips have uttered.
I will be true to my agreement; the things which have gone out of my lips will not be changed.
